page_title: BBC Learning English - English at Work / The Wedding Day
title: The Wedding Day
description:
The day has finally come – Anna and Tom are getting married. All their friends, work colleagues and business acquaintances are there but when the ceremony begins will Anna know what to say?
This episode focuses on the language that you might use during a wedding ceremony.
phrases: Thank you for your kind offer but I will have to decline.

listening_challenge.question: What does Mr Socrates offer Tom?
listening_challenge.answer: A job as manager at the office in Paris.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Hello and welcome to English at Work where the day has finally come – it's Anna and Tom's wedding. All their friends, work colleagues and business acquaintances are there… such as Mr Lime…

transcript.speaker: Mr Lime
transcript.text: Fantastic Anna, fantastic!

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Yuk, Slimey Limey, I never liked him.  Sorry about the venue Anna – but it's all we could get at short notice.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: I think the office at Tip Top Trading is an ideal place for a wedding and besides the…

transcript.speaker: Mr Socrates
transcript.text: Anna! My favourite girl.  I got here as fast I could. I thought I was the only man for you but I guess Tom has stolen that title! Your choice Anna, your choice!

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Oh hello Mr Socrates, this is a nice surprise. Come over here and say hello to Tom.

transcript.speaker: Mr Socrates
transcript.text: Hey Tom.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Oh hello Mr S. Nice to see you. You're not doing any firing today are you?

transcript.speaker: Mr Socrates
transcript.text: Of course not Tom. In fact, as a kind of wedding present, I wondered if you wanted a new job? I'm offering you a chance to manage my new office in Paris.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Me?! Manager… in Paris! Well Mr S…

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Tom… aren't we about to get married… start a life together?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Oh yes.. erm, thanks Mr S for you kind offer but I will have to decline. I'm about to spend the rest of my life with this wonderful woman.

transcript.speaker: Registrar
transcript.text: Ladies and gentlemen, please could you take your seats. The marriage ceremony is about to begin. Do you Anna Jane Wijaya...

transcript.speaker: Mr Socrates
transcript.text: …out the way, give me that paper. Do you Anna Jane Wijaya take Tom Brian Farquhar Darcy … to be your lawfully wedded husband? To have and to hold from this day forward?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Ermm,  errr…

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Come on Anna. This is the most important phrase in the whole series!  It's 'I do'!

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Oh yes, of course… I do.

transcript.speaker: Mr Socrates
transcript.text: And do you, Tom Brian Farquhar Darcy…

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: …it's a deal… I do. Come on Anna, give us a kiss.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Oh Denise!

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Ahh. It looks like Tom has signed the best contract of his career but not without these phrases:
Thank you for your kind offer but I will have to decline
It's a deal
I do!

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Thanks to everyone for making this a special day. If it wasn't for Tip Top Trading I wouldn't be starting a new life as Mrs Wijaya-Darcy.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Wijaya-Darcy? Shouldn't it just be Mrs Darcy?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: I'm the boss now Tom at work… and at home!

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Congratulations to Anna and Tom. We have a happy ending – let's hope Anna's journey has inspired you to learn English at work.

transcript.speaker: Everyone
transcript.text: Bye!
